rules.text: If a pie chart's printed slice labels are treated as the current Europe smartphone market-share values, the brand whose printed percentage is numerically greatest is the current market-share leader.
rules.conditions: The chart is the Europe smartphone market-share dashboard; printed percentages are comparable market-share values; the task's decision metric is market_share.

rules.text: If the public task's budget rule requires allocating the premium EU retail promotion budget to the current market-share leader, the public option naming that leader is the supported action.
rules.conditions: The selected option must name the brand identified as the leader; the budget rule and review scope match the chart's Europe smartphone brands.

rules.text: If a pie chart's printed percentage labels are not accepted as authoritative market-share values, the chart alone cannot establish which brand has the highest current market share.
rules.conditions: No external data or policy threshold is supplied; only visible marks and literal inscriptions may be used.
